official_definition: "Mealtiply: Cost X or less - (When Summoned) You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon one Cost X or less "Drifting Spirit" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned or remaining cards."

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Mealtiply] or [Mealtiply: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Mealtiply]", "give [Mealtiply]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
